models.name: zenodo-unet-gends-onnx
models.notes: Zenodo GenDS reference, converted to ONNX (scripts/convert_models_to_onnx.py). The golden-fixture model; runs TF-free via onnxruntime.

models.name: twostage-baseline-hdf5
models.notes: Self-trained baseline (R Keras 2.15, twostage_lrfix GenDS10). KNOWN NON-CONFORMANT (2026-07-11): saved with 256x256 input, violates the 512 contract — as do twostage_lrcarry and singlestage_SpecDS on the volume. Runs only with config.img_width/height=256 override. Kept in the manifest so the failure stays visible until a 512 export exists.

models.name: twostage-baseline-512transfer
models.notes: twostage_lrfix_GenDS10 rebuilt at 512x512 via architecture patch + weight transfer (2026-07-11). VERDICT: mechanically conformant but scale-shift degrades it badly (IoU 0.351 vs its own native-256 output; 542 fragmented parts -> 97 stems; volume 19.5 vs 34.7 m3). EXPERIMENT ONLY — do not use for production; retrain at 512 instead.

models.name: twostage-unet-onnx
models.notes: PyTorch twostage_lrfix UNet, ONNX export. Hypothesis: same behavior as twostage-baseline-hdf5.
